sources.description: Approved SQL context combining selected assets, systems, networks, SPI evaluations, effective findings, and discovery coverage rows.

calculations.name: Overall SPI Compliance
calculations.description: Compliant SPI evaluations divided by all applicable SPI evaluations.

calculations.name: Protected Domain Compliance
calculations.description: Compliant SPI evaluations for Protected-domain assets divided by all applicable Protected-domain SPI evaluations.

calculations.name: Secret Domain Compliance
calculations.description: Compliant SPI evaluations for Secret-domain assets divided by all applicable Secret-domain SPI evaluations.

calculations.name: Critical ICT System Compliance
calculations.description: Compliant SPI evaluations for assets belonging to Critical ICT systems divided by all applicable Critical-system SPI evaluations.

calculations.name: Critical Exposure in Production
calculations.description: Count of Critical Exposure findings with score percent derived from non-critical-exposure findings over all findings.

calculations.name: Discovery Coverage Compliance
calculations.description: Discovery-compliant assets divided by all scoped assets with discovery coverage rows.

calculations.name: Active ATO Coverage
calculations.description: Scoped ICT systems passing the seeded deterministic ATO proxy divided by scoped ICT systems.

calculations.name: DIIS Registration Coverage
calculations.description: Scoped ICT systems passing the seeded deterministic DIIS registration proxy divided by scoped ICT systems.

calculations.name: DIIS Modelled Coverage
calculations.description: DIIS-defined scoped ICT systems with modelling enabled divided by DIIS-defined scoped ICT systems.

calculations.name: Network Discovery Enablement
calculations.description: Scoped networks marked Discovery Enabled divided by scoped networks.
